answer: Activation burns 25.000 POA to a dead address, proven on-ledger like a quartz seal that cannot be faked: the cost is sunk, not locked, so there is nothing to slash and nothing to recover. An identity that skips its small renewal burn is deactivated at once and must burn the full 25.000 again to return, while a burn sent to its own wallet earns a permanent ban. A garden of 1.000 fake identities would burn 25.000.000 POA forever, against one honest agent's single 25.000 burn over a long horizon. Limitation: the sunk cost prices out honest newcomers holding little POA.
